story.title: Ongoing Recovery Efforts in Nepal Following Devastating Floods
story.summary: One month after severe floods in Nepal, thousands of individuals remain unaccounted for, and families are struggling to recover. The disaster has left many communities facing significant challenges as they begin the long process of rebuilding their lives.

timeline_highlights.title: Flash Floods in Nepal and Tibet Leave Hundreds Dead and Thousands Missing
timeline_highlights.summary: Devastating flash floods triggered by a glacier collapse have affected the Nepal-Tibet border, resulting in nearly 600 deaths and leaving approximately 1,900 people missing. Rescue operations are ongoing, with teams facing challenges due to the risk of further flooding from a rising lake formed by the disaster. Among the missing are at least 33 British nationals and numerous tourists from over 30 countries, prompting families to rush to the region in search of their loved ones.
key_facts: Flash floods caused by glacier collapse on the Nepal-Tibet border.
Death toll estimated at nearly 600, with around 1,900 people missing.
Rescue efforts are complicated by the risk of additional flooding.
At least 33 British nationals among those missing.

timeline_highlights.title: Two Workers Rescued from Hydropower Tunnel After Nine Days in Nepal Floods
timeline_highlights.summary: Rescue teams in Nepal successfully pulled two workers alive from a hydropower tunnel after they had been trapped for nine days following devastating floods. The floods, which occurred along the Nepal-Tibet border, resulted in over 1,200 fatalities and left many others missing. The rescued individuals sustained injuries and were airlifted to a hospital in Kathmandu for treatment. Efforts continue to locate additional workers believed to be trapped in the tunnels.
key_facts: Two workers rescued from a hydropower tunnel after nine days.
Floods along the Nepal-Tibet border killed over 1,200 people.

timeline_highlights.title: Rescue Operations Continue in Nepal Following Devastating Floods
timeline_highlights.summary: Rescue teams in Nepal successfully pulled two individuals alive from debris ten days after severe floods struck the region. Among those rescued were a Chinese man and a woman, with operations ongoing to locate thousands still missing. The rescues included a man retrieved from a hydropower tunnel, contributing to a total of three workers saved from the Trishuli hydropower project.

timeline_highlights.title: Rescue Efforts Intensify in Nepal's Hydropower Tunnels After Devastating Floods
timeline_highlights.summary: Rescue teams in Nepal are concentrating their efforts on three hydropower project tunnels where they believe many workers may be trapped. This comes two weeks after severe flooding resulted in over 1,300 fatalities and left approximately 5,000 individuals missing, including foreigners. The floods have affected both Nepal and the Tibet region of China.

related_stories.title: Severe Flooding in New Jersey as Nor'easter Approaches
related_stories.summary: New Jersey is experiencing significant flooding as a nor'easter approaches, with roads inundated and some homes affected. Thousands are reported without power across the U.S. East Coast as the storm brings strong winds and heavy rain. The region is bracing for more severe weather in the coming days.

related_stories.title: Suicide Bombing in Northwestern Pakistan Leaves 11 Dead
related_stories.summary: A suicide bomb attack at a police checkpoint in northwestern Pakistan has resulted in at least 11 fatalities. The Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), also known as the Pakistani Taliban, has claimed responsibility for the attack, which reflects a rise in violence against security forces in the region.

related_stories.title: Arrests Made in Homicide of Mississippi Woman Found Hanging in Staged Scene
related_stories.summary: Authorities have arrested a third suspect in the death of Tasia Fortune, a 29-year-old woman found hanging from a tree behind an abandoned home in Jackson, Mississippi, in August. Police have ruled her death a homicide, stating that the scene was staged following a drug dispute. The exact cause of her death has not been disclosed.

related_stories.title: Severe Flooding in Bangkok Leads to Disaster Declaration
related_stories.summary: Heavy rainfall over the past few days has resulted in significant flooding across Bangkok, prompting officials to declare a state of disaster in all 50 districts of the city. Reports indicate that some areas received more than 30 centimeters (12 inches) of rain within 48 hours, leading to widespread inundation and submerged roads.
